label: Kpower
description: Adds a virtual power meter to your Karoo, estimating power from a physics model when you don't have a real power meter. With a real ANT+ meter, it records the Cycling Dynamics the Karoo can't.
releaseNotes: More accurate power: fresher grade + auto surface from offline maps. New: multi-bike per ride profile, real ANT+ meter with Cycling Dynamics, power offset. Less battery use. The weight field now means bike + gear — re-check yours. Coming from <1.9.5? Uninstall first.
